b: Tara Cunningham’s latest mini-LP of small wonders proves a perfect counterpoint to our outsized era, says Bernie Brooks

We’re living through an era of apocalyptic sizing, of catastrophic scale. El Niño, high temperatures, glacier melt, funding cuts, deregulation, wealth inequality, the AI bubble, etc. Even the good stuff is epochal. In the US, the Democrat win a week or so ago was Texas-sized. If all this XXXL news were as peachy as that, that’d be one thing, but it isn’t. It mostly isn’t. And that’s more than mostly exhausting.
So, imagine my delight when the new Tara Cunningham record, Warm Ground, described in the presser as a mini-LP of miniatures, appeared – as if by providence...
